verifications.claim: NASA's Artemis II mission is scheduled to launch no earlier than April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Artemis II begins its journey to the moon | CNN (https://www.cnn.com/2026/04/01/science/live-news/artemis-2-nasa-launch)'; R2: 'Artemis 2 launched on April 1'; R3: 'Artemis II (April 1, 2026)'; R4: 'Artemis 2 launched on 1 April 2026'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm the launch occurred on April 1, 2026, matching the scheduled 'no earlier than' date.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first crewed flight to the Moon in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'first time astronauts return to the vicinity of the moon in more than 50 years'; R3: 'first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972'; R4: 'first crewed mission to circle the moon in over 50 years'
verifications.reasoning: All sources explicitly state it is the first crewed lunar mission since 1972, over 50 years.
